## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Saṁghabheda Sutta* is the eighth discourse of the fifth chapter (*Soṇavagga*) of the *Udāna* in the Khuddaka Nikāya, referenced at page 60 of the Pali Text Society edition. The narrative relates to the impending schism within the monastic community, recording the episode where Devadatta declares his intention to cause a split in the Sangha.

This Vinaya parallel is corroborated by DharmaNexus, which detects extensive Pali-internal text reuse between segments 1.3–6.4 of the sutta and Kd 17 (§§3.17.1–3.17.16), sharing roughly 1,791 characters [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also records substantial overlap with the *Dhammapada-aṭṭhakathā* (§§4.1–6.4), as well as shared formulaic phrases across various Nikāya discourses (including AN 7, SN 12, MN 86, and DN 16) and a cross-language alignment with the Sanskrit *Saṅghabhedavastu* [DharmaNexus]. None of the examined secondary literature passages treat this specific *Udāna* discourse directly, referring instead to the general institutional concept of schism or to Vinaya narrative works.

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog and DharmaNexus data.*
